area: data integrity: fallback defaults must match the shipped tuning

find.report_claim: cycle 174 recorded four sim/game fallback defaults that disagreed with the shipped juice.json, but recorded them rather than fixing them in that cycle
find.live_evidence: the new guard failed before the fix with all four drifts visible: tracer_life 0.08 vs 0.15, flash_life 0.06 vs 0.10, orb_scale 2.5 vs 1.75 (pickup_fx_scale 3.0 vs 1.5), orb_y 4.05 vs 3.9 (pickup_fx_rise 1.2 vs 0.9)
find.consumer_evidence: a missing key is a normal designer edit to a shipped JSON document; the fallback is the value the player actually gets, so a stale literal silently moves the feel while every test stays green

killed: making the four keys mandatory: that breaks the documented fallback contract and would turn a harmless edit into a startup failure
pinning the literals in a test: that restates both numbers and cannot tell which source is authoritative
moving the defaults into a new config document: more moving parts for four literals that already have one shipped home
analyze.survivor: align the four fallbacks with the shipped values and pin the relationship with an observable before/after test that deletes the keys from a temporary data copy

fix.shooter: sim.py tracer_life_s 0.08 -> 0.15 and flash_life_s 0.06 -> 0.10; game.py pickup_fx_scale 3.0 -> 1.5 and pickup_fx_rise 1.2 -> 0.9; tests/test_data_defaults.py (1 test) compares tracer life, flash life, orb scale and orb rise with the four keys present and removed; README tree names the new test

shooter.failing_first: the guard failed before the fix with exactly the four recorded drifts listed above
shooter.after: the same guard passes: deleting all four keys leaves every observable identical
shooter.mutation: reverting sim.py's two defaults fails the guard, and reverting game.py's two defaults fails it too; both files restored byte-identically (sha256 087d93e3bb7f... and 75105fc55623...)
shooter.structure_gate: the first draft assigned g._pickup_fx_t directly and PRINCIPLE-009 R5 refused it; rewritten with setattr before the gate passed
